newsitem.title: FINLAND: GOVT SAYS 13,500 SUBSCRIBED KEMIRA SHARES.
newsitem.headline: GOVT SAYS 13,500 SUBSCRIBED KEMIRA SHARES.

text.p: Some 13,500 private investors subscribed shares in chemicals and fertiliser group Kemira Oy in the government's offering of six million shares in the group, the Ministry of Trade and Industry (KTM) said on Thursday.
"Some 13,800 investors, 13,500 of which were private, participated in the offering," it said.
"The number of shares subscribed in the offering exceeded the offered six million by almost 34 percent," it said.
The ministry said it had decided to approve all bids up to 500 shares and about 50 percent of all bids over 500 shares.
"Private investors got 78 percent of their subsciptions on average," it said.
